_doc: Dated events the desk is waiting on. A catalyst due today or yesterday heads the shortlist and the brief lint warns until the page carries a line on its name. date: the day, UTC. name: the config/names id. what: one line on what is due. check: where the outcome is likely to appear first. source: where the date came from. Remove an event once its outcome is on the page.

events.name: cnam
events.what: Cnam and the lab unions: decisive conventional meeting on the tariff framework after the 2024 to 2026 protocol (talks opened 23 Jul); outcome sets French lab tariffs for Biogroup, Cerba, Inovie, Synlab
events.source: Le Quotidien du Médecin, 8 Oct 2026: PLFSS 2027, réunion conventionnelle décisive (meeting set for 12 Oct)

events.name: cnam
events.what: Government action plan on the financialisation of healthcare and the independence of health professionals, presented 11:30 Paris by Stéphanie Rist (health) and Serge Papin (SMEs, commerce); the investor-owned lab groups (Biogroup, Cerba, Inovie, Synlab) are the most exposed
events.source: La Veille Acteurs de Santé press agenda, Government, 13 Oct 2026, 14 avenue Duquesne

events.name: paragon
events.what: Paragon (PCC Global) audited full-year results to 30 June 2026, presentation 09:30 BST

events.name: branicks
events.what: Vote without a meeting on the EUR 400m 2.25% green bond runs 17 to 19 Oct (registration by 16 Oct); the company says its continued existence is at immediate risk without a creditor solution
events.source: Bond invitation of 2 Oct 2026; EGM release 9 Oct 2026

events.name: airbaltic
events.what: Final hearing in the Chapter 11 (SDNY, case 26-12188) on the EUR 350m DIP financing (the remaining EUR 35m of tranche 1, then tranches 2 and 3), cash management and the Seabury retention (EUR 250k a month, success fees capped at EUR 18m), 18:00 Riga, 15:00 UTC; continuation 20 Oct 20:00 Riga if needed. The Ad Hoc Group of 2029 noteholders objects to the DIP priming its collateral; the EUR 257m 25% bondholder financing plan is dropped.
events.source: BNN and nra.lv 16 Oct 2026 (LETA), citing the 16 Oct court filing; the 9 Oct hearing postponed the final DIP order to 19 Oct

events.name: branicks
events.what: The vote without a meeting on the EUR 400m 2.25% green bond (XS2388910270) closes 24:00 CET: split into EUR 258.8m secured 7.5% due 30 Sep 2030 plus about EUR 151.4m unsecured subordinated 15% PIK-able due 30 Sep 2038; quorum 50% of nominal, 75% of votes cast, fallback second meeting quorate at 25%; 63.6% of the volume under support agreements at 28 Sep. Result expected by ad hoc on 20 Oct.
events.source: Münster Aktuell 17 Oct 2026 citing the 2 Oct voting invitation and the 15 Oct ad hoc

events.name: avis
events.what: Avis Budget Group Q3 2026 results, after the US close

events.name: hellofresh
events.what: HelloFresh Q3 2026 results (FY26 guidance cut on 24 Sep)
